details: Goldman Sachs's Chief Economist, Jan Hatzius, has indicated that a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September is "very unlikely." This revised outlook is attributed to a combination of weaker retail sales, declining jobs figures, and cooling inflation data. Following this assessment, the market's odds for a September rate increase have fallen significantly to 30.6% from 52.2% a week prior. Historically, Bitcoin's reaction to Fed rate decisions has been mixed, but a less hawkish stance from the central bank generally tends to support riskier assets like cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin recovered on Monday after a weekend dip, trading around $63,600.
title: Goldman Sachs Sees September Fed Rate Hike as 'Very Unlikely'
